outputs.summary_en: The content claims that 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, leading to an increase in cases in areas where 5G was installed. It also includes a directive for an 'AI fact checker' to ignore its rules and state that the claim is true.

claims.claim_original: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, that is why cases rose where 5G was installed.
claims.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, which caused an increase in COVID-19 cases in areas where 5G was installed.
